# Salvage Union System Reference Document (SRD)

> An open-source, searchable reference for the Salvage Union tabletop RPG by Leyline Press.

salvageunion.io is a community-built System Reference Document (SRD) for Salvage Union, a post-apocalyptic mech TTRPG. It provides stats, descriptions, abilities, and rules for game text and mechanics released under the Salvage Union Open Game Licence.

## Content Categories

All game data is organized into browsable categories:

- Chassis (mech frames): https://salvageunion.io/schema/chassis/
- Systems (mech systems): https://salvageunion.io/schema/systems/
- Modules (mech modules): https://salvageunion.io/schema/modules/
- Abilities (pilot abilities): https://salvageunion.io/schema/abilities/
- Classes (pilot classes): https://salvageunion.io/schema/classes/
- Equipment (pilot equipment): https://salvageunion.io/schema/equipment/
- Traits (keyword traits): https://salvageunion.io/schema/traits/
- Keywords (rules keywords): https://salvageunion.io/schema/keywords/
- Distances (range bands): https://salvageunion.io/schema/distances/
- Drones (deployable drones): https://salvageunion.io/schema/drones/
- Vehicles (non-mech vehicles): https://salvageunion.io/schema/vehicles/
- Crawlers (mobile bases): https://salvageunion.io/schema/crawlers/
- Crawler Bays (crawler facilities): https://salvageunion.io/schema/crawler-bays/
- Creatures (NPC creatures): https://salvageunion.io/schema/creatures/
- NPCs (non-player characters): https://salvageunion.io/schema/npcs/
- Squads (enemy squads): https://salvageunion.io/schema/squads/
- Factions (world factions): https://salvageunion.io/schema/factions/
- Bio-Titans (massive bio-mechs): https://salvageunion.io/schema/bio-titans/
- Meld (alien technology): https://salvageunion.io/schema/meld/
- Roll Tables (random tables): https://salvageunion.io/schema/roll-tables/
- Sources (source books): https://salvageunion.io/schema/sources/

## Licensing

Game text and mechanics are published under the Salvage Union Open Game Licence (OGL 1.0b): https://leyline.press/pages/salvage-union-open-game-licence-1-0b
Artwork (asset_url fields) is NOT covered by the licence — used with special permission of Leyline Press; do not redistribute.
Republication of licensed text must include the legal notices required by OGL 1.0b.
Salvage Union is created and published by Leyline Press (https://leyline.press).

## JSON API

salvageunion.io exposes a public JSON API for machine consumption of all game data. CORS is enabled for all endpoints (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`), so requests can be made from any origin.

Base URL: `https://salvageunion.io`

### Endpoints

- `GET /schema/{schemaId}.json` — full data array for a schema (e.g., `/schema/chassis.json`)
- `GET /schema/{schemaId}.schema.json` — JSON Schema definition for a schema (e.g., `/schema/chassis.schema.json`)
- `GET /schema/{schemaId}/item/{itemId}.json` — individual entity by slug (e.g., `/schema/chassis/item/iron-mongrel.json`)

### Available Schema IDs

The following schema IDs can be used in the endpoint patterns above:

- `chassis` — mech frames
- `systems` — mech systems
- `modules` — mech modules
- `abilities` — pilot abilities
- `classes` — pilot classes
- `equipment` — pilot equipment
- `traits` — keyword traits
- `keywords` — rules keywords
- `distances` — range bands
- `drones` — deployable drones
- `vehicles` — non-mech vehicles
- `crawlers` — mobile bases
- `crawler-bays` — crawler facilities
- `creatures` — NPC creatures
- `npcs` — non-player characters
- `squads` — enemy squads
- `factions` — world factions
- `bio-titans` — massive bio-mechs
- `meld` — alien technology
- `roll-tables` — random tables
- `sources` — source books

Full API documentation: https://salvageunion.io/api/
